attempts.summary: Configured node1 (VyOS) as a router between lan-a (eth1, node2's segment) and lan-b (eth2, node3's segment), using pure routing/forwarding (no NAT) so node2 and node3 reach each other directly on any port with original source addresses preserved. Added persistent static IPs and cross-LAN static routes on node2/node3 (RHEL7), and opened firewalld to the peer subnet on each. Verified via ICMP, TCP (arbitrary port 8765 HTTP), and conntrack (no address translation, ASSURED bidirectional flow). All three nodes were then restarted one at a time via native `systemctl reboot`, with boot_id proven to change and post-restart config/connectivity re-verified for each before moving to the next node.
